- **Fair Value of Conversion Discount**: $201 million (Source: `documents/report.md`)

\[ \text{Portion} = \frac{\text{Professional Fees}}{\text{Total Reorganization Items, Net}} \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Portion} = \frac{183}{2429} \times 100 \approx 7.54\% \]
